Events · revision archive

History

The same events, one row per revision.

GET /api/v1/history

Filters= query params of /api/v1/history

layerany of · empty = all layers
place
from
to
page_size

These are the events from the Events browser, unrolled. That screen shows each event once, as it stands now; this one shows every revision it has passed through — so you read the arc, not the current state. A row is a revision, carries its rev n, and opens the same record its counterpart on Events opens. Absence is recorded as deliberately as onset: "nothing here now" is a fact you can trace to the revision that made it true, never inferred from an empty screen.

Request
Returns
grid.v1.EventRevisionList
revisions[].{
revision, observedAt, ingestedAt, event }

RFC 3339 · newest first · pages by next_page_token · days grouped in UTC

from/to are entered in your local time and sent as UTC — the echoed request shows exactly what went over the wire.

Clock caveat

Ordering is by observedAt, which is upstream-stamped. Mesh nodes timestamp their own adverts from an unsynchronized clock, so a MESH revision can carry a future time and sort above newer records. Reported verbatim — we do not rewrite it. For when this service learned something, read ingestedAt.
